parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the structural skeleton of the storage cabinet, made of steel for rigidity and durability.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and stability to the entire cabinet, holding all other parts together.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed component and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom platform of the cabinet, made of steel to support the weight of stored items.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the load of the cabinet and ensures stability on the floor.
parts.Movement_description: It is stationary and does not move during normal operation.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Left)
parts.Basic_description: The left cabinet door is a wooden panel attached to the frame with hinges.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the interior of the cabinet when opened and conceals contents when closed.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Right)
parts.Basic_description: The right cabinet door is a wooden panel similar to the left door, attached with hinges.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the cabinet interior and closes to protect stored items.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: The shelf is a flat wooden board placed inside the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It divides the cabinet interior into sections for organized storage of items.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed but may be adjustable in height depending on design.
